description: TokenWise: run recognized Bash commands through `tokenwise run`, which filters their output (CodeBuddy's permission check still runs on the command as written); LightShadow, a mod, keeps compacted tool results recallable. At startup, say so if the tokenwise command is missing.

hooks.command: command -v tokenwise >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"systemMessage":"TokenWise: the tokenwise command is not on PATH, so the plugin does nothing yet. Install it: https://github.com/Zongwei9888/tokenwise#install"}'
